title: EOS — fail closed on blocked or incomplete worker outcomes
intent:
Correct the EOS completion-semantic defect exposed by Issues #834 and #835. A worker process returning normally must not be persisted as COMPLETE when its content explicitly reports a blocker, unmet completion criteria, missing required execution capability, or an implementation that was not artifactized as requested.

Required work:
Introduce a deterministic outcome gate between provider/runtime completion and EOS final-status persistence.

The gate must derive status from structured execution evidence and completion criteria, not from process exit alone.

At minimum distinguish:
- COMPLETE: all required completion criteria satisfied and required artifacts/evidence exist.
- BLOCKED_EXECUTION: required tool/capability unavailable or denied, so requested work could not be executed.
- AWAITING_ARTIFACTIZATION or equivalent: implementation/evidence exists but required governed patch/PR/artifact was not created.
- RETURN_FOR_CORRECTION: verifier/content mismatch or correctable defect.
- ESCALATE/OWNER_ACTION_REQUIRED: genuine protected Owner boundary.

Requirements:
1. Do not rely only on free-text keyword matching. Bind final status to request completion criteria, expected artifact types, verifier result, runtime/tool receipts, and produced artifacts where available.
2. Explicit worker statements such as blocked/denied/cannot complete must be treated as corroborating evidence and may never be silently normalized to COMPLETE.
3. A zero exit code or provider COMPLETE result is necessary but not sufficient for EOS COMPLETE.
4. Required test/build/lint evidence must be present when the request requires it.
5. Required PR/patch/durable artifact must exist when the request requires it.
6. Preserve #820 maximum-two-correction behavior and Gateway/Verifier fail-closed semantics.
7. Preserve Claude routing, Cortex READ_ONLY_PILOT, Agent Manager, integration authority, and cost/capacity semantics.
8. Add regressions reproducing #834 and #835 closely enough to prove they no longer become COMPLETE.
9. Add a positive regression proving a genuinely satisfied request still becomes COMPLETE.
10. Do not rerun #834/#835 until this correction is independently reviewed, CI-green, and merged.

Evidence to encode in regressions:
- #834 was persisted COMPLETE even though Claude explicitly stopped before cycle 1 because Bash/test/worker execution was denied. No remediation cycles occurred.
- #835 was persisted COMPLETE even though Claude reported git/PR writes denied and the requested draft PR/governed artifact outcome was not produced.

Completion:
Draft PR with implementation, tests, documentation/status-schema impact, and explicit mapping of #834/#835 to corrected statuses. Do not merge automatically.
scope: This correction is limited to EOS intake/runtime outcome classification and related tests/docs. Preserve Claude routing, Cortex READ_ONLY_PILOT, Agent Manager, Gateway/Verifier, integration authority, and cost/capacity semantics except where outcome classification must consume their structured evidence. Do not rerun #834 or #835 in this issue.
